# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOLATILITY_SQUEEZE_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Low volatility contractions often precede expansion; entering on the break of the contraction band captures the ensuing move. The 5-period ATR squeezing to its lowest value of the past 20 periods for three consecutive 5-minute bars, combined with price being within the prior day's high-low range, identifies a coiled spring. A break above/below the squeeze band with above-average volume captures the directional expansion.

## Mechanism
Entry: When the 5-period ATR contracts to its lowest value of the past 20 periods for three consecutive 5-minute bars and price is within the prior day's high-low range, enter long on a close above the highest high of the squeeze period (short on close below lowest low) with the bar's volume > average volume of the squeeze period.  
Exit: Initial stop at the opposite extreme of the squeeze band (chart-stop), target 1.5R, then trail remaining half with a premium-stop % of 1.0% from the highest high (long) or lowest low (short).  
Regime filter: Only active when VIX < 20 and time between 11:00-13:30 EST; avoid during major news releases (FOMC, CPI).
